interpretation: Original = este checkpoint sin editar, no la media del paper. Comparaciones con los mismos pacientes y ruido; cohortes distintas no se comparan entre sí. Benchmark reutilizado: V1 ya se había evaluado en este test.
scope_note: Series of comparable 128-patient, 100-imputation trials. Earlier 24-patient/10-imputation memory exploration and runtime-only repeats are retained in the complete trial ledger, not mixed into these curves.
